Name: unit01:reading:1
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit01", "question": "What can we learn from the conversation with trusted others?", "options": ["To converse with ourselves and be honest with ourselves.", "To keep up with the latest technological developments.", "To raise our expectations of online connection.", "To avoid saying anything truly self-reflective."], "answer": 0, "explanation": "第10段：正是通过与信任的人交谈，我们学会与自己对话、对自己诚实（learn to converse with ourselves – to be honest with ourselves）。"}

Name: unit01:reading:2

To make room for it, I see some first steps. 可见作者坚定支持交谈。"}

Name: unit01:reading:3
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit01", "question": "What is the author’s suggestion for evaluating our relationship with technology?", "options": ["Ban all digital devices at home and at work.", "Ask experts to monitor how much time we spend online.", "Replace face-to-face conversation with online connection.", "Take some time away from devices to assess the merit and burden of technology."], "answer": 3, "explanation": "第12段：Let’s take some time away from the beeps and rings to evaluate our relationship with technology，并权衡数字技术的 merit and burden。"}

Name: unit01:reading:4
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit01", "question": "He entered the film industry, taking small roles and writing ______ for a famous film company.", "options": ["scenarios", "conventions", "chores", "deletions"], "answer": 0, "explanation": "scenario 除“可能发生的情况”外，还可指电影、戏剧的“剧情梗概”；为电影公司写“剧情梗概”用复数 scenarios。"}

Name: unit01:reading:5
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit01", "question": "In doing translation, one should not ______ the meaning of the original to suit one’s own taste.", "options": ["assess", "immerse", "alter", "collaborate"], "answer": 2, "explanation": "alter the meaning 意为“改变原意”，与 to suit one’s own taste（迎合自己的口味）搭配。"}

Name: unit01:reading:6
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit01", "question": "Without warning, there was a(n) ______ storm and the waves swept over the boat.", "options": ["observant", "furious", "discrete", "sacred"], "answer": 1, "explanation": "furious 除“狂怒的”外，还可修饰 storm，表示“猛烈的、强烈的”。"}

Name: unit01:reading:7
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit01", "question": "Doctors consider it their ______ duty to protect and save the lives of their patients.", "options": ["identical", "continual", "deceptive", "sacred"], "answer": 3, "explanation": "sacred duty 是固定搭配，意为“神圣的职责”；sacred 在此不表示宗教意义，而指“很重要的、深受尊重的”。"}

Name: unit01:reading:8
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit01", "question": "The question was how to maintain that kind of ______ for a vehicle that weighed considerably more than 3,300 pounds.", "options": ["velocity", "volume", "adequacy", "nuance"], "answer": 0, "explanation": "velocity 指“速度”，与 maintain（保持）搭配，说的是重量超过3,300磅的车辆如何保持那种速度。"}

Name: unit01:reading:9
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit01", "question": "They are able to take ______ ideas, thoughts, and generalizations and weave them into meaningful patterns.", "options": ["sacred", "identical", "discrete", "observant"], "answer": 2, "explanation": "discrete 意为“分开的、离散的”，discrete ideas 指零散的想法，与后文 weave them into meaningful patterns 呼应。"}

Name: unit02:reading:0
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit02", "question": "What order did Zheng He receive when he was appointed to head the massive fleet in 1405?", "options": ["To build more than 200 new junks for the emperor.", "To conquer the trading ports of the Arabian Peninsula.", "To establish ties with rulers all around the Indian Ocean.", "To bring back rare wood, pearls, and exotic animals."], "answer": 2, "explanation": "第6段：皇帝命他率领两百多艘帆船的庞大船队，并下旨与印度洋周边的统治者建立联系（a royal order to establish ties with rulers all around the Indian Ocean）。"}

Name: unit02:reading:1
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit02", "question": "How did Zheng He impress the rulers he encountered?", "options": ["With his diplomatic skills and the elaborate gifts he brought.", "With the size of his fleet and the number of his soldiers.", "With his knowledge of the ports of Yemen and Saudi Arabia.", "With the Chinese silk and porcelain he sold at low prices."], "answer": 0, "explanation": "第7段：当地统治者对他的外交才能（diplomatic skills）和他带来的精美礼物印象深刻，并同意派使者到明朝。"}

Name: unit02:reading:2
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit02", "question": "Why did the royal court draw military investment away from the maintenance of the Treasure Fleet?", "options": ["Because pirates had destroyed most of the fleet.", "Because Zheng He had died and no one could replace him.", "Because the emperor wanted to spend the money on new trade pacts.", "Because the war in the north led the court to focus on building and expanding the Great Wall."], "answer": 3, "explanation": "第9段：北方的战争使军费不再用于船队维护，朝廷转而修建和扩建长城，海军随之萎缩，大型船只被毁。"}

Name: unit02:reading:3
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit02", "question": "What is the influence of Zheng He’s seven expeditions on maritime exploration according to Para. 10?", "options": ["They pushed the limits of boats’ size, complexity, and capacity for long-distance travel.", "They proved that long-distance sea travel was too dangerous to continue.", "They replaced gunpowder and the compass with new Chinese technologies.", "They persuaded Asian rulers to stop trading across the Indian Ocean."], "answer": 0, "explanation": "第10段：七次远航挑战了人类在海上能做到的事，把船只的规模、复杂程度和远距离航行能力推向极限，并传播了火药和指南针。"}

Name: unit02:reading:4
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit02", "question": "The eastern area is three times bigger than the western area, featuring ______ tropical rainforests and giant waterfalls.", "options": ["vague", "frail", "dense", "royal"], "answer": 2, "explanation": "dense 表示“茂密的”，dense tropical rainforests 即茂密的热带雨林，与 giant waterfalls 并列描写东部地区。"}

Name: unit02:reading:5
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit02", "question": "In the meeting, a new manager was ______ to take charge of the project which was in financial difficulties.", "options": ["appointed", "escorted", "patrolled", "expanded"], "answer": 0, "explanation": "appoint sb. to do sth. 表示“任命某人做某事”，此处用被动 was appointed to take charge，说明新经理被任命接手项目。"}

Name: unit02:reading:6
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit02", "question": "Services such as cooking, cleaning, and ______ the elderly to hospitals are in high demand.", "options": ["patrolling", "escorting", "appointing", "maintaining"], "answer": 1, "explanation": "escort sb. to somewhere 表示“护送某人去某地”，与 cooking、cleaning 并列作 Services 的内容，故用动名词 escorting。"}

Name: unit02:reading:7
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit02", "question": "A high-tech police car capable of immediately detecting stolen cars, disqualified drivers, and other offenses is ______ the roads.", "options": ["escorting", "maintaining", "expanding", "patrolling"], "answer": 3, "explanation": "patrol the roads 表示“在道路上巡逻”，主语是高科技警车，用现在分词 patrolling 构成现在进行时。"}

Name: unit02:reading:8
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit02", "question": "Around 300 workers and engineers are working hard for the timely delivery of the project despite its ______.", "options": ["realm", "complexity", "patrol", "expansion"], "answer": 1, "explanation": "despite its complexity 表示“尽管项目复杂”，complexity 指“复杂性”，符合 despite 后接名词的用法。"}

Name: unit02:reading:9
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit02", "question": "A researcher said China’s fast economic ______ in recent years has made great contributions to world economic growth.", "options": ["expansion", "maintenance", "complexity", "escort"], "answer": 0, "explanation": "economic expansion 表示“经济扩张（增长）”，与 in recent years 以及“对世界经济增长的贡献”搭配。"}

Name: unit03:reading:0
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit03", "question": "How does a bit of distance help enhance creativity according to Para. 6?", "options": ["It removes all the familiar things from our daily life.", "It makes the brain spend less time choosing what to notice.", "It lets us see ordinary things from a more abstract angle and combine the new with the old.", "It proves that literal prose is more useful than symbolic verse."], "answer": 2, "explanation": "第 6 段：一点距离能松开禁锢我们的认知枷锁，使我们更容易把新与旧混合，并从略为抽象的角度把握平凡事物。"}

Name: unit03:reading:1
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit03", "question": "What are the characteristics of seasoned travelers?", "options": ["They are open to ambiguity and refuse to settle for their first answers.", "They accept no interpretation of the world other than their own.", "They prefer to travel only in countries with a similar culture.", "They depend on guidebooks for every decision they make."], "answer": 0, "explanation": "第 7 段：老练的旅行者对模糊性持开放态度，承认存在多种同样有效的理解世界的方式，并不断扩大“认知输入”的范围，不肯停留在最初的答案上。"}

Name: unit03:reading:2
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit03", "question": "What do we need to do to trigger our creativity?", "options": ["Simply fly a long distance to another latitude and longitude.", "Stay at home and read more guidebooks about foreign countries.", "Change cultures and experience the disorienting diversity of human traditions.", "Avoid all confusing situations while travelling abroad."], "answer": 2, "explanation": "第 8 段强调：这种思维灵活性并非来自单纯的距离（纬度经度的改变），而要改变文化、体验人类传统令人迷失的多样性。"}

Name: unit03:reading:3
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit03", "question": "Why do we travel according to Para. 9?", "options": ["Because distance and difference are the secret cornerstones of creativity.", "Because we enjoy lost luggage and jet lag.", "Because we want to change the city we live in.", "Because we need to prove that home is boring."], "answer": 0, "explanation": "第 9 段结尾：我们旅行是因为需要，因为距离与差异是创造力的秘密基石；回家后家还是原来的样子，但我们的心智已被改变。"}

Name: unit03:reading:4
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit03", "question": "Thanks to its nine-year ______ education, China has one of the highest literacy rates in the world, which is a great achievement.", "options": ["compulsory", "stubborn", "trivial", "corporate"], "answer": 0, "explanation": "nine-year compulsory education 是固定说法“九年义务教育”，compulsory 意为“义务的、强制的”；其余形容词与 education 搭配不通。"}

Name: unit03:reading:5

Name: unit03:reading:6

Name: unit03:reading:7
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit03", "question": "In the 1970s, the firm was restructured to ______ the business and pursue new areas of growth.", "options": ["loosen", "groan", "contemplate", "globalize"], "answer": 3, "explanation": "globalize the business 意为“使业务全球化”，与 pursue new areas of growth 并列。"}

Name: unit03:reading:8

Name: unit03:reading:9

Name: unit04:reading:0

Name: unit04:reading:2
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit04", "question": "What kind of attitude should people take toward leisure time?", "options": ["They should waste it in the trivial pursuit of games and fashion.", "They should use it to improve their minds and working conditions and create a happier, more contented life.", "They should spend it working extra hours for more money.", "They should ignore it and concentrate only on their jobs."], "answer": 1, "explanation": "第 7 段：不必对闲暇持 toxic attitude，人们 now use their leisure time to improve their minds and their working conditions to create a happier, more contented life，如终身学习。"}

Name: unit04:reading:3

Name: unit04:reading:4
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit04", "question": "He is measuring the depth of the hole to ______ how much climbing line we'll need to get us down and back up again.", "options": ["foster", "gauge", "suffice", "contend"], "answer": 1, "explanation": "gauge 意为“（根据所掌握的信息）估计、判断”，与 measuring the depth 呼应；foster 培养、suffice 足够、contend 竞争/主张均不合。"}

Name: unit04:reading:5
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit04", "question": "He ______ for the lead in the final round, but ultimately finished in second position.", "options": ["conformed", "fostered", "contended", "correlated"], "answer": 2, "explanation": "contend for the lead 意为“争夺领先位置”，contend for 是固定搭配；conform 遵从、foster 培养、correlate 关联均不能与 for the lead 搭配。"}

Name: unit04:reading:6
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit04", "question": "Smartphone conversations, which are fairly ______ on commuter trains, can be annoying to fellow commuters.", "options": ["commonplace", "adverse", "upcoming", "voluntary"], "answer": 0, "explanation": "commonplace 意为“常见的、屡见不鲜的”，修饰 on commuter trains 上普遍存在的现象；adverse 不利的、upcoming 即将来临的、voluntary 自愿的语义不符。"}

Name: unit04:reading:7
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit04", "question": "Ask your doctor whether a low-fat diet and a daily walk will ______ to lower your high blood pressure.", "options": ["foster", "contend", "conform", "suffice"], "answer": 3, "explanation": "suffice to do sth. 意为“足以做某事”，符合“低脂饮食加每天散步是否足以降压”的语境。"}

Name: unit04:reading:8
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit04", "question": "According to the latest statistics, most of the company's ______ is generated through the sale of smartphones.", "options": ["diversion", "autonomy", "revenue", "precision"], "answer": 2, "explanation": "revenue 意为“（公司或组织的）收入，收益”，与 is generated through the sale 搭配；diversion 消遣、autonomy 自主、precision 精确均不合。"}

Name: unit04:reading:9
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit04", "question": "Scientists have learned more about the ______ effects that human activities have on the environment and climate.", "options": ["medieval", "voluntary", "upcoming", "adverse"], "answer": 3, "explanation": "adverse effects 是固定搭配，意为“不利影响、负面影响”，与 human activities 对环境的作用相符。"}

Name: unit05:reading:2

Name: unit05:reading:3

Name: unit05:reading:4
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit05", "question": "All these industries have ______ the decline and in some cases reversed it by innovations of their own.", "options": ["embodied", "simulated", "halted", "ascended"], "answer": 2, "explanation": "halt 意为“（使）停止”，halt the decline 指“遏止下滑”；embody（体现）、simulate（模拟）、ascend（上升）均不合搭配。"}

Name: unit05:reading:5
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit05", "question": "The city has recently devised a series of strategies mapping out a(n) ______ for the city's development.", "options": ["boundary", "blueprint", "milestone", "oscillation"], "answer": 1, "explanation": "blueprint 指“蓝图、规划”，map out a blueprint for ... development 是常用搭配；boundary（边界）、milestone（里程碑）、oscillation（摆动）都不能与 map out 搭配表示“规划”。"}

Name: unit05:reading:6
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit05", "question": "Research laboratories could ______ environmental conditions surrounding historical sites to help researchers with their cultural heritage protection endeavors.", "options": ["ascend", "halt", "simulate", "vibrate"], "answer": 2, "explanation": "simulate 意为“模拟”，simulate environmental conditions 即“模拟环境条件”，符合实验室研究的语境。"}

Name: unit05:reading:7
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit05", "question": "My phone ______ in my pocket while I was walking around the mall.", "options": ["vibrated", "halted", "embodied", "simulated"], "answer": 0, "explanation": "vibrate 指“振动”，手机在口袋里振动用 vibrated；其余三词分别表示停止、体现、模拟，均不能描述手机。"}

Name: unit05:reading:8
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit05", "question": "This meeting proved to be a very important ______ for the development of the program.", "options": ["boundary", "blueprint", "organ", "milestone"], "answer": 3, "explanation": "milestone 指“里程碑、重大事件”，an important milestone for the development of ... 表示“项目发展的重要里程碑”。"}

Name: unit05:reading:9
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit05", "question": "The drought has ______ a direct agricultural economic loss of 952 million dollars in that area.", "options": ["ascended", "vibrated", "inflicted", "embodied"], "answer": 2, "explanation": "inflict 意为“使遭受（不愉快的事）”，inflict a loss on ... 指“造成损失”；此处 inflict a direct agricultural economic loss 表示“造成直接农业经济损失”。"}

Name: unit06:reading:0

Name: unit06:reading:1

Name: unit06:reading:2

Name: unit06:reading:3
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit06", "question": "What does the author intend to tell us by Sue’s story?", "options": ["Charities are more helpful than government programs.", "Unemployment benefits should be abolished.", "Moving back to one’s hometown is the best solution.", "An economic crisis can push an ordinary person with a decent job into deep poverty and despair."], "answer": 3, "explanation": "全文以 Sue 从公司主管沦落到住汽车旅馆的经历，说明经济危机如何一步步侵蚀普通人的收入、居住、教育与信心。"}

Name: unit06:reading:4
